name: creditsync
description: Private CreditSync borrower, payment, floating-interest, disbursement, renewal, and reversal workflows for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Review and manage private CreditSync workflows.
interface.longDescription: Use the private CreditSync app to resolve borrowers, manage effective-dated floating interest, capture evidence, post allocations and disbursements, renew daily loans, and create audited reversals.
defaultPrompt: Find a borrower and show outstanding loans.
Record a loan disbursement with evidence.
Schedule a future floating-loan interest rate.
